definitions.explanation: A physical position of readiness, especially in martial arts, sports, or combat. The way one positions the body in preparation for action.
A mental state of readiness or a particular attitude toward something. Used figuratively to describe being prepared or on guard.
The external appearance or imposing size of a building or establishment.

examples.japanese: {剣道|けんどう}の{構|かま}えをとる。
{上段|じょうだん}の{構|かま}えから{打|う}ち{込|こ}む。
examples.english: To strike from a high guard position.

examples.japanese: {相手|あいて}の{攻撃|こうげき}に{対|たい}して{身構|みがま}えの{構|かま}えをとった。
examples.english: I took a defensive stance against the opponent's attack.

examples.japanese: {気楽|きらく}な{構|かま}えでいい。
{何|なに}があっても{動|どう}じない{構|かま}えだ。
examples.english: He has an attitude of not being fazed by anything.

examples.japanese: {試験|しけん}に{向|む}けて{万全|ばんぜん}の{構|かま}えで{臨|のぞ}む。
examples.english: I will approach the exam fully prepared.

examples.japanese: {立派|りっぱ}な{構|かま}えの{屋敷|やしき}だ。
examples.english: It's a mansion with an impressive appearance.

examples.japanese: {大|おお}きな{構|かま}えの{店|みせ}が{通|とお}りに{並|なら}んでいる。
{門|もん}{構|がま}えからして、かなり{裕福|ゆうふく}な{家|いえ}のようだ。
examples.english: Judging from the gate's appearance, it seems to be a quite wealthy household.

notes:
The noun form of {構|かま}える (to set up, to take a stance). The reading changes from かまえ to がまえ when used as a suffix in compounds like {門構|もんがま}え and {身構|みがま}え (rendaku).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {構|かま}えをとる — to take a stance/posture
- {上段|じょうだん}の{構|かま}え — high guard (kendo/martial arts)
- {中段|ちゅうだん}の{構|かま}え — middle guard
- {門構|もんがま}え — the appearance of a gate/entrance
- {身構|みがま}え — bracing oneself, being on guard

USAGE:
- In martial arts, specific stances have fixed names: {上段|じょうだん}/{中段|ちゅうだん}/{下段|げだん}の{構|かま}え
- As a suffix, undergoes rendaku: {心構|こころがま}え (mental preparedness), {門構|もんがま}え (gate appearance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {姿勢|しせい} — posture; physical body alignment, not necessarily implying readiness for action
- {態勢|たいせい} — readiness, preparation; more about organizational or systemic preparedness
- {心構|こころがま}え — mental preparedness; specifically about psychological readiness
